name: Example trips give 64 days used and 26 left

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
Scroll to the trip list and click 'Try an example' (data-testid=trip-example)
The trip list (data-testid=trip-list) shows exactly 3 trip rows (data-testid=trip-row), for 2026-05-22 to 2026-06-10, 2026-07-21 to 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-13
The overstay tile (data-testid=overstay-status) reads 'No overstay' and the presence tile (data-testid=present-status) reads 'Outside'
